groups.contract: Raised step topology and numeric publication
groups.disposition: State identifies one supporting foot through swing. Stationary turn begins exactly one swing, advances checked interval, alternates next foot at completion. Finite final target validation surrounds native reach adjustments; adjusted target does not assert actual rendered support. keep_swing_ahead and interpolation are native kernels with subsequent target validation, not independently admitted durable geometry.

ReachLimit intentionally delays native arithmetic until full geometry operation. Checked measured segment lengths; analytic solver rejects short limbs and inverted/NaN distance bounds before clamp, then rejects nonfinite knee/end. This differs from pose-buffer small-limb clamp alias NATIVE-INITIAL05-F011. Partial live hierarchy rotation is sequential and not transactional. Existing normal-size, unreachable, straight and twist-chain fixtures personally read but not run. Huge native intermediate overflow alone is not promoted if final admission rejects/sanitizes it.

groups.contract: Stop capture, cancellation and terminal convergence
groups.disposition: Capture requires an observed swing foot; root is only COM fallback. Candidate capture and landing checked before seed/support/settle publication. Checked elapsed/progress advances copied state. Restart retains acquired contacts and seeds unacquired from last rendered endpoints. Terminal idle requires both ankle and toe terrain evidence; support/plan cleanup and absolute pelvis shift transfer prevent repeated accumulation. Seeded versus prepared TerminalContacts semantics remain next-body dependency.

Planar speed admitted before discontinuity clearing; first pelvis sample deliberately adopts desired while later zero elapsed holds. finish_terrain_release clears plants, endpoint caches and plan start/phase metadata but leaves left/right_planned_contact; coordinator can prefer retained contact in a later approach. This is a retained-plan lifecycle question needing exact re-enable/cadence producer proof and canonical expected ownership; no ordinary stale-contact defect promoted solely from omission. Publication validator is next original role. Diagnostics reprojects release targets natively, no claim it re-admits arithmetic.
